visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a cinematic product showcase against a solid black background. A cylindrical titanium cup with a dark, charcoal-like textured finish is positioned centrally on a dark, circular rotating platform. Bold yellow and white Chinese text overlays are positioned at the top of the frame. The lighting is studio-focused, creating subtle highlights on the metallic surface of the cup as it remains static. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of multiple titanium cups in vibrant colors, including purple, electric blue, gold, and iridescent pink. A cross-section graphic of a cup appears, showing a golden interior wall and a hollow double-layered structure. The setting alternates between a clean studio and a workshop background filled with organized power tools and hardware. The main character, a male with a beard and glasses wearing a grey baseball cap and a grey jacket, appears outdoors on a balcony with green trees behind him, drinking from the cup. (3) The demonstration phase features extreme close-ups of the cup's rim placed next to a silver coin to illustrate its thinness. The man is then shown in the workshop, opening a silver beer can and pouring it into the dark titanium cup. White, fine foam builds up within the cup. The character gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera, showcasing the product range. The final frame displays a group of colorful cups with a QR code and promotional text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic electronic music track featuring a prominent synthesizer lead and a rhythmic drum beat. A male narrator introduces the product with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. The BGM remains consistent in the background as he describes the cup's Japanese origins. (2) A transition occurs marked by a subtle whoosh sound effect. The narrator's pitch fluctuates to emphasize key structural features like the 'double-walled' insulation. Short pauses in speech allow the driving electronic beat to maintain the video's momentum. (3) A sharp, metallic 'click' sound is heard, clearly identifiable as a beverage can being cracked open. This is immediately followed by a high-frequency liquid splashing and fizzing sound as beer is poured into the cup. The BGM ducks slightly to allow these foley sound effects to stand out. (4) The final phase features a digital UI 'ping' sound effect accompanying the display of the QR code. The narrator delivers a high-arousal closing statement with rising intonation, urging the audience to take action before the music reaches a final peak and ends on a hard cut.
